_comment: Precision wave-farming registry: every gate/wave the divers round-robin over. Each entry: path (the active_wave.php query, exactly as the game's wave router wants it), label (shown on the dashboard) and rewardCapLv (the wave's 'Rewards Up To LV X' level gate — past that level the wave drops gear/items but NO exp/gold; the divers' picker sinks such waves to the back for accounts above the cap; 0 = unknown). Live-verified 2026-11: Grakthar wave 1 reads 'Rewards Up To LV 300'. Event waves (event=N&wave=M) are discovered dynamically at sweep time from event_page.php and merged here at runtime — no need to list them. Edit freely — restart the server after. A WAVE_PAGES env var overrides this file; the built-in defaults in server/waves.js are the fallback.
